explore.purpose: List visible Snapshot files under a directory.
explore.description: List visible Snapshot files below a relative directory.

glob.purpose: Find visible Snapshot paths matching a pattern.
glob.description: Find visible Snapshot paths matching a POSIX glob pattern.

grep.description: Search visible Snapshot text with a regular expression.

read_file.purpose: Read a bounded range from the current Snapshot file.
read_file.description: Read a bounded line range from a visible Snapshot file.

instruction_loader.purpose: Load the applicable repository rules before reviewing one changed file.
instruction_loader.parameters: path: exact repository-relative Review file path
instruction_loader.description: Load the ordered repository instructions applicable to one exact repository-relative Review file path.

get_diff.purpose: Read the fixed base-to-head diff for a changed file.
get_diff.description: Read the base-to-head diff for a changed visible file.

read_revision.purpose: Read a bounded base or head revision of a visible file.
read_revision.description: Read a bounded base or head revision of a visible Snapshot path.

comment.description: Submit one or more concrete changed-code comments for deterministic resolution.

task_done.description: Declare that changed-file investigation is complete without creating a Finding.
